blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Diffusion models have greatly advanced instruction-guided image editing, while also raising concerns about unauthorized image manipulation. Image immunization addresses this risk by adding imperceptible perturbations to an input image to disrupt subsequent edits. Since editing requests are unknown at image release, protection should remain effective beyond the instruction used to construct the perturbation. Existing immunization methods either require costly full-trajectory backpropagation or use intermediate objectives whose effects may be weakened by subsequent denoising. Meanwhile, a single inference path provides limited feedback about alternative denoising continuations. To address these challenges, we propose SPIN , a framework for image immunization via one-step projection over local stochastic trajectory neighborhoods. Starting from an early denoising state, SPIN generates stochastic neighboring states under the same instruction and predicts their clean latents through one-step projection without full unrolling. We then optimize a bounded input perturbation to maximize the average deviation of these predictions from a clean-edit reference, encouraging the perturbation to disrupt multiple possible editing outcomes. Experiments on two image editors demonstrate substantial gains in protection performance, with SPIN outperforming compared methods across all six metrics under seen instructions and in the more challenging unseen instruction setting.
blocks.zh: 传播模型已经大大地提前了指令引导图像编辑,同时也引起了对未经授权的图像操纵的关注. 图像免疫通过在输入图像中增加难以察觉的扰动来应对这种风险,以打乱随后的编辑. 由于编辑请求在图像发布时并不为人所知,因此在用于构建扰动的指令之外,保护仍应有效. 现有的免疫方法要么需要昂贵的全外向回传播,要么使用中间目标,其影响可能因随后的去诺而削弱。 同时,一个单一的推论路径对替代去名续作提供了有限的反馈. 为了应付这些挑战,我们提议通过一个步骤,将图像免疫框架覆盖到地方的有条理的行迹区。 从早期的去诺状态开始,SPIN在同一指令下产生有花样的相邻状态,并通过不完全不滚动的单步投影来预测其干净的潜质. 然后,我们优化了限制输入扰动,使这些预测与干净编辑参考值之间的平均偏差最大化,鼓励扰动扰乱多种可能的编辑结果. 对两个图像编辑器的实验表明,保护性能大有提高,SPIN在根据可见的指示和更具挑战性的无形指示环境中,在所有6个度量标准中,其比比方法要好。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Instruction-guided diffusion models have made it possible to modify a source image using natural-language instructions while preserving content unrelated to the requested changes ( Brooks et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) . Publicly available image editing models have substantially lowered the barriers to personalized image manipulation. However, the same accessibility also makes publicly released images vulnerable to unauthorized editing, which may compromise personal privacy and reputation or facilitate misleading content. Deepfake detection ( Rossler et al., 2019 ) and AI-generated image detection ( Ojha et al., 2023 ) can identify manipulated content, but operate only after such content has been produced. This motivates proactive protection that is embedded imperceptibly in images before release.
blocks.zh: 指令制导的传播模型使得使用自然语言指令来修改源图像成为可能,同时保留了与所请求的修改无关的内容(Brooks等,2023;Zhao等,2024.). 公开的图像编辑模型已经大大降低了个人化图像操纵的障碍. 然而,同样的可访问性也使得公开发布的图像容易受到未经授权的编辑,这可能会损害个人隐私和声誉或为误导内容提供方便. 深假检测(Rossler等,2019年)和AI生成的图像检测(Ojha等,2023年)可以识别被被操纵的内容,但只能在此类内容被制作后运行. 这激励了在发布前在图像中隐含的主动保护.

blocks.en: Image immunization protects source images by adding imperceptible perturbations that disrupt subsequent unauthorized edits. A direct approach optimizes perturbations against the final editing output, but backpropagation through the denoising trajectory incurs substantial computational cost ( Salman et al., 2023 ) . More efficient alternatives construct surrogate objectives from denoising predictions or intermediate representations ( Liang et al., 2023 ; Liang and Wu, 2023 ) . Such objectives can target encoder representations ( Xue et al., 2024 ) , instruction-related cross-attention ( Lo et al., 2024 ) , or early denoising states ( Choi et al., 2025 ) , providing protection signals through shorter gradient paths.
blocks.zh: 图像免疫通过增加无法察觉的扰动来保护出源图像,这些扰动会打乱后续未经授权的编辑. 采用直接方法对最终编辑产出进行优化,但通过去诺化轨迹进行反向传播,则会产生大量的计算成本(Salman等人,2023年)。 更有效率的替代品通过去诺预测或中间表示构建代位目标(梁等,2023;梁等和吴等,2023.). 此类目标可以针对编码符表示(薛等,2024年),与指示相关的交叉注意(洛等,2024年),或早期去名状态(崔等,2025年),通过更短的梯度路径提供保护信号.

blocks.en: Nevertheless, deviations induced by intermediate representations may be attenuated by subsequent denoising, weakening their effect on the final edit. Protection under a fixed editing instruction may also depend on the specific sampling trajectory. This dependence becomes particularly relevant when future editing requests are unknown, as a single trajectory offers limited feedback about other possible continuations. The challenge is therefore to construct an effective optimization signal that reflects the perturbation’s impact on editing outcomes across multiple possible continuations, enabling protection beyond the original editing instruction.
blocks.zh: 然而,中间表述引起的偏差可能会被随后的去名所缓解,削弱其对最后编辑的影响. 固定编辑指令的保护还可能取决于具体的取样轨迹。 当未来的编辑请求未知时,这种依赖就变得特别相关,因为单一的轨迹对其他可能的续作提供的反馈有限. 因此,挑战在于构建一个有效的优化信号,反映扰动对多种可能续作的编辑结果的影响,从而能够在原始编辑指示之外提供保护。

blocks.en: We address this challenge by proposing SPIN (Single-step Projection in Stochastic Neighborhoods), an image-immunization framework that uses predicted editing outcomes to guide protective perturbations. Single-step projection predicts a clean latent from an early denoising state. The discrepancy between this prediction and a fixed clean-edit reference provides an effective surrogate for optimizing perturbations that disrupt the final editing output. To extend this signal beyond a single inference path, SPIN generates neighboring candidate states through stochastic transitions from a shared early state. We then optimize a bounded input perturbation to maximize the average discrepancy between their projected outcomes and the reference, reducing dependence on a single construction path and promoting generalization to unseen editing instructions.
blocks.zh: 我们通过提出SPIN(Sing-step Project in Stochastic Neigborhoods)来应对这一挑战,这个图像免疫框架利用预测的编辑结果来指导保护性扰动. 单步投影预言从早期的去诺状态中可以得到干净的潜伏. 这种预测与固定的清洁编辑参考之间的差异为优化干扰干扰最终编辑输出提供了有效的代用. 为了将这个信号延伸至单一推论路径之外,SPIN通过从共享的早期状态来产生相邻的候选状态. 然后,我们优化了限制输入扰动,最大限度地缩小其预测结果与参考文献之间的平均差距,减少对单一构建路径的依赖,并推广对无形编辑指令的通俗化。

blocks.en: Experiments on SD3 and InstructPix2Pix show that SPIN outperforms all baselines across six metrics under both seen and unseen editing instructions. Immunization success rates reach 90% and 94% under seen instructions (85% and 91% under unseen instructions), consistently exceeding those of competing methods. Ablations demonstrate that single-step projection provides an effective protection signal, while stochastic neighborhood sampling further improves generalization over single-candidate projection.
blocks.zh: 关于SD3和InstructPix2Pix的实验表明,SPIN在可见和看不见的编辑指令下,在6个度量线上都超过了所有基线. 免疫接种成功率达到90%,在所见指示下达到94%(85%,在未见指示下达到91%),始终超过相互竞争的方法。 通缩表明单步投影提供了有效的保护信号,而有花样的相邻采样比单步投影进一步提高了通缩性.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose SPIN , an image-immunization framework that uses single-step projection to guide perturbation optimization with predicted editing outcomes, providing an effective signal for disrupting the final edit. • We introduce stochastic neighborhood optimization to construct a single perturbation that targets multiple possible continuations of the editing process. By driving their projected outcomes away from the clean-edit reference, this strategy promotes disruption across different inference paths and improves generalization to unseen editing instructions. • Experiments under standard editing pipelines show that SPIN consistently outperforms the evaluated baselines in immunization success rate under both seen and unseen instructions, across flow-matching and noise-prediction diffusion editors.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Instruction-Guided Diffusion Image Editing
blocks.zh: 2.1 指导传播图像编辑

blocks.en: Diffusion models support image editing by combining a generative prior with a source image and user-specified control. SDEdit ( Meng et al., 2022 ) perturbs and denoises an input through a stochastic differential equation to balance faithfulness and realism. Later methods introduced more explicit semantic control. Prompt-to-Prompt ( Hertz et al., 2023 ) manipulates cross-attention maps to preserve spatial layout while changing textual content, whereas Imagic ( Kawar et al., 2023 ) optimizes a text embedding and fine-tunes the model for semantic edits on a single image. InstructPix2Pix ( Brooks et al., 2023 ) establishes a supervised learning paradigm for directly following natural-language editing instructions without per-image inversion or fine-tuning. UltraEdit ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) advances this paradigm through large-scale editing supervision with diverse instructions, real-image anchors, and region annotations, supporting the adaptation of pretrained generative models, including Stable Diffusion 3 ( Esser et al., 2024 ) , to instruction-guided image editing. These advances improve the capability and accessibility of image editing, while also exposing publicly released images to increasingly diverse unauthorized transformations.
blocks.zh: 分泌模型支持图像编辑,将先基因后基因与源图像和用户指定控制相结合. SDedit (Meng等, 2022年)通过分层微分方程来扰动并取出一个输入来平衡忠诚与现实. 后来的方法引入了更明确的语义控制. 即时到Prompt(Hertz等,2023年)在改变文字内容的同时操纵交叉意向图来保持空间布局,而Imagic(Kawar等,2023年)则优化了文本嵌入并微调了单一图像上语义编辑的模式. 指令Pix2Pix(Brooks等,2023年)为直接遵循自然语言的编辑指令建立了有监督的学习范式,没有逐一反演或微调. 超强 Edit (Zhao等,2024年)通过有多种指令的大规模编辑监督,实相主播,以及区域说明等,推进了这一范式,支持了包括Stable Divusion 3(Esser等,2024年)在内的经过事先训练的基因模型被改编为指导性图像编辑. 这些进步提高了图像编辑的能力和可获取性,同时也使公开发布的图像暴露于日益多样化的未经授权的转换.

blocks.en: 2.2 Adversarial Examples
blocks.zh: 2.2 负面实例

blocks.en: Norm-bounded adversarial perturbations can alter model predictions ( Goodfellow et al., 2015 ) , and projected-gradient methods ( Madry et al., 2018 ) formulate their construction as constrained optimization. To improve cross-model transferability, MI-FGSM ( Dong et al., 2018 ) stabilizes updates through momentum, while VMI-FGSM ( Wang and He, 2021 ) further refines them using neighborhood gradient information. EOT ( Athalye et al., 2018 ) averages attack objectives over input transformations to improve transformation robustness, whereas universal adversarial perturbations generalize across images ( Moosavi-Dezfooli et al., 2017 ) . SPIN targets the generation trajectories of diffusion editors, optimizing a bounded input perturbation over local stochastic continuations to disrupt generation and drive final editing outputs away from their clean counterparts.
blocks.zh: 受约束的对抗性扰动可以改变模型预测(Goodfellow等,2015年),而预测分级方法(Madry等,2018年)则将其构建为受限优化. 为提升跨模式可移植性,MI-FGSM(Dong等,2018年)通过动力稳定了更新,而VMI-FGSM(Wang和He,2021年)则利用邻里梯度信息来进一步完善. EOT(Athalye等,2018年)平均攻击目标而不是投入转化,以提高转化稳健性,而普遍对抗性扰动则泛指图像(Moosavi-Dezfooli等,2017年)。 SPIN针对的是传播编辑器的生成轨迹,优化了对局部有花样的续作的限定输入扰动,以打乱生成,并驱使最终编辑产出远离干净的对应物.

blocks.en: 2.3 Image Immunization Against Diffusion Editing
blocks.zh: 2.3 防止传播的图像免疫编辑

blocks.en: Image immunization methods mainly differ in the optimization signal used to construct protective perturbations. PhotoGuard exposes the central trade-off through an efficient encoder-targeting objective (PhotoGuard-E) and a more output-related but expensive full-diffusion objective (PhotoGuard-D) ( Salman et al., 2023 ) . AdvDM optimizes the diffusion denoising loss, while MIST combines semantic and textural objectives to disrupt the generation process at multiple representation levels ( Liang et al., 2023 ; Liang and Wu, 2023 ) . Subsequent methods shorten the gradient path by targeting specific internal components: SDS ( Xue et al., 2024 ) applies score distillation at the vulnerable VAE bottleneck, EditShield ( Chen et al., 2024 ) shifts instruction-conditioned latent representations, and SA ( Lo et al., 2024 ) disrupts prompt-relevant cross-attention features. DiffusionGuard ( Choi et al., 2025 ) places its objective at early denoising stages. Other approaches improve complementary aspects of protection: DCT-Shield ( Bala et al., 2025 ) optimizes frequency-domain perturbations for visual fidelity and JPEG resistance, whereas SIFM ( Dong et al., 2025 ) combines intermediate-feature manipulation with semantic and perceptual criteria for evaluating edit failure. Despite their different targets, these methods either require costly differentiation through the diffusion trajectory or rely on internal surrogates whose deviations may be attenuated during subsequent denoising.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We present an image-immunization framework, termed Single-step Projection in Stochastic Neighborhoods ( SPIN ), for protecting images against unauthorized editing. To efficiently obtain a protection signal that reflects the perturbation’s effect on the predicted edit, we use single-step projection to estimate the clean latent from an intermediate denoising state. We further optimize the perturbation over a local stochastic neighborhood to reduce dependence on a single inference path and promote generalization across editing instructions.

blocks.en: 3.2 Overall Framework
blocks.zh: 3.2 总框架

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of SPIN . From a shared native prefix, local trajectory sampling generates neighboring candidates and one-step projection estimates their clean endpoints. These estimates guide perturbation optimization to drive editing outputs away from the fixed clean-edit reference.
blocks.zh: 图1:SPIN概览. 从一个共享的本土前缀中,本地的轨迹采样产生相邻的候选者,并单步投影估计其干净的终点. 这些估算指导了扰动优化,以驱使编辑产出远离固定的清洁编辑参考.

blocks.en: Our goal is to construct a bounded input perturbation that disrupts the final editing output and remains effective under unseen editing instructions. To this end, SPIN combines two modules, as shown in Figure 1 : (a) local trajectory sampling generates neighboring candidate states from a shared early state under a fixed construction instruction, providing feedback across multiple local continuations to reduce path dependence and support transfer to unseen instructions; (b) one-step projection estimates each candidate’s clean latent, enabling output-oriented evaluation without full sampling rollouts. We aggregate the projected candidates’ deviations from a fixed clean-edit reference to optimize the same input perturbation. The following subsections detail the projection, neighborhood construction, and perturbation optimization.
blocks.zh: 我们的目标是构建一种有限度的输入扰动,干扰最终的编辑输出,并且在无形的编辑指令下依然有效. 为此,SPIN结合了两个模块,如图1所示:(a) 当地轨迹取样在固定施工指令下从共享的早期状态产生相邻的候选状态,在多个局部续作中提供反馈,以减少路径依赖性并支持转移到隐形指令;(b) 单步预测估计每个候选状态的清洁潜伏性,使得能够进行面向产出的评价而无需全面展开取样。 我们汇总了预计候选人偏离固定的清洁编辑方法,以优化相同的输入扰动。 以下分节详述了投影,街区建设,和扰动优化.

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup and Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 4.1 设立和评价议定书

blocks.en: We construct a benchmark of 500 samples from Pico-Banana, covering landscapes, artworks, multi-object scenes, real-world photographs, news imagery, public figures, and indoor scenes. For text-conditioned protection methods, perturbations are optimized using the original prompt associated with each image. Each sample is evaluated with its original prompt and five semantically disjoint editing instructions, resulting in 3,000 image-instruction pairs. Additional dataset and instruction details are provided in Appendix A.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们从Pico-Banana建造了500个样本的基准, 包括景观、艺术品、多物体场景、真实世界的照片、新闻图像、公众人物和室内场景。 对于有文字条件的保护方法,使用与每个图像相联的原始提示来优化扰动. 每个样本都用其原始的即时和5个分解的编辑指令进行评估,结果产生了3000个图像指令对. 附录A.1提供了补充数据集和说明细节。

blocks.en: We evaluate InstructPix2Pix and Stable Diffusion 3 (SD3) as denoising-diffusion and flow-matching editors, respectively. We compare edits of clean and protected inputs using PSNR ( Wang and Bovik, 2009 ) , SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , FSIM ( Zhang et al., 2011 ) , VIFP ( Sheikh and Bovik, 2006 ) , and LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) . Lower values of the first four and higher LPIPS indicate stronger protection; the directions reverse for perturbation imperceptibility. Following SIFM ( Dong et al., 2025 ) , we report Immunization Success Rate (ISR): the fraction of protected edits with instruction failure or substantial perceptual degradation, judged by consensus of Kimi K2.5 ( Team et al., 2026 ) and Qwen3-VL ( Bai et al., 2025 ) . Higher ISR indicates stronger protection. See Appendices A.2 and D for evaluation details.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: We first compare SPIN with representative image-immunization methods, PhotoGuard-E/PhotoGuard-D ( Salman et al., 2023 ) , SDS ( Xue et al., 2024 ) , ED ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , AdvDM ( Liang et al., 2023 ) , MIST ( Liang and Wu, 2023 ) , SA ( Lo et al., 2024 ) , DCT ( Bala et al., 2025 ) , and SIFM ( Dong et al., 2025 ) on SD3 and InstructPix2Pix under the instructions used to construct the protected inputs. Table 1 shows that SPIN achieves the greatest output discrepancy and highest immunization success rate on both editors. Compared with objectives defined on intermediate features or noisy states, our projection objective targets deviations in predicted editing outcomes, aligning perturbation optimization more closely with final-edit disruption and thereby improving immunization performance.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced SPIN to protect images against unauthorized editing by jointly considering the predicted outcomes of multiple local editing trajectories. This formulation makes output-oriented protection tractable without differentiating through the full denoising process. It also allows a protective perturbation to account for alternative continuations of an edit, rather than relying on a single construction path. Together, these ideas offer a practical direction for image immunization when future editing requests are unknown at the time of image release.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了SPIN,通过联合考虑多个本地编辑轨迹的预测结果来保护图像不被未经授权的编辑. 这种提法使面向产出的保护在不通过完全去名化程序加以区分的情况下能够加以推广。 它还允许保护性扰动来说明编辑的可选续作,而不是依赖单一的构造路径. 这些想法共同为未来在图像发布时未知编辑请求时的图像免疫提供了一个实用的方向.

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work studies image immunization against unauthorized instruction-guided image editing. Although our method employs adversarial attacks, its objective is defensive: to help image owners protect their content by applying bounded perturbations before publication, reducing the risk of unwanted manipulation. The method operates on input images while keeping the editing models frozen. The same perturbation mechanism could also be used to disrupt legitimate editing workflows. We therefore encourage its use on images that users own or are authorized to protect. Our experiments use images from Pico-Banana, and the edited examples serve to evaluate protection effectiveness. They should not be interpreted as authentic depictions of people or events.
blocks.zh: 这项工作研究了图像免疫与未经授权的教学指导图像编辑。 虽然我们的方法使用对抗攻击,但它的目标是防御性:帮助图像所有者通过在出版前运用有限度的扰动来保护它们的内容,降低不受欢迎地被操纵的风险. 这种方法在输入图像上运行,同时使编辑模型保持被冻结. 同样的扰动机制也可以被用来干扰合法的编辑工作流程. 因此,我们鼓励将其用于用户拥有或授权保护的图像。 我们的实验利用了皮克-巴纳纳的图像,经过编辑的例子有助于评估保护的有效性。 它们不应被解释为对人或事件的真实描述。

blocks.en:
We follow the ISR protocol introduced by SIFM ( Dong et al., 2025 ) . For each
evaluation sample, Kimi K2.5 and Qwen3-VL independently inspect the source
image, the edited output produced from the protected image, and the editing
instruction. Each evaluator returns binary judgments for two failure modes:
(1) semantic mismatch, where the output does not realize the intended edit,
and (2) substantial perceptual degradation, where artifacts, distortions, or
other quality defects make the output unusable. A model-level verdict is
positive when either failure mode is present.
